basic_info.description: Limited Time Opportunity in Nob Hill's Gramercy Towers! Transparent Pricing.....   Perched high above San Francisco, this elegant 1-bedroom, 1-bath residence with parking showcases sweeping Golden Gate Bridge and Bay views. The ideal city sanctuary or sophisticated pied--terre, this home offers an effortless lock-and-leave lifestyle in one of Nob Hill's most exclusive addresses. Residents enjoy world-class amenities: 24/7 attended lobby, heated indoor pool with retractable sunroof, spa, sauna, fitness center, and acclaimed Osso Steakhouse just downstairs. HOA dues provide unmatched valuecovering all utilities, high-speed internet, cable TV, earthquake insurance, master insurance, water, garbage, reserves, parking, storage, and professional management. Steps to Huntington Park, the Fairmont, Union Square, theaters, Chinatown, and the Financial District. With a 98 Walk Score (Walker's Paradise) and 100 Transit Score (Rider's Paradise), everything the city offers is at your doorstep. An extraordinary opportunity for those seeking prestige, convenience, and a refined San Francisco retreat. Photos have been virtually staged to help  visualize design and layout.
